Class BaseSearchNode<T extends BaseSearchNode<T>>

java.lang.Object
org.engine.ai.BaseSearchNode<T>
Direct Known Subclasses:
IsmctsNode, MctsNode
public abstract class BaseSearchNode<T extends BaseSearchNode<T>> extends Object
Abstract node in a game-tree search.

Maintains visit counts, accumulated margin sums, and parent/child links shared by all implemented search algorithms.

    • calculateUCT

      public abstract double calculateUCT(double explorationConst, double[] globalMinMargins, double[] globalMaxMargins, int parentActivePlayerIndex)
      Calculates the Upper Confidence Bound applied to Trees (UCT) value.

      UCT = normalised_exploitation + C * sqrt(ln(timesAvailable) / timesExplored)

      Exploitation is the average margin for the active player, normalised to [0, 1] using the global min/max bounds tracked by the tree.

      Parameters:
      explorationConst - weight for the exploration term
      globalMinMargins - per-player running minimum of all simulation margins
      globalMaxMargins - per-player running maximum of all simulation margins
      parentActivePlayerIndex - ordinal of the player to move at the parent node
      Returns:
      the computed UCT score

    • calculateMargins

      public static double[] calculateMargins(Map<Player,Integer> finalScores, GameSettings.RankingOrder rankingOrder)
      Computes each player's score advantage relative to the best-scoring opponent. If the game settings dictate that the lowest score wins, this margin is negated.
      Parameters:
      finalScores - the final scores mapped by player
      rankingOrder - the ruleset determining whether high or low scores win
      Returns:
      an array of calculated margins ordered by player ordinal
